scripts.dev: npm run docker:infra && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @djs/shared-types && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @djs/api && npm run build -w @djs/worker && npm run build -w @djs/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @djs/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @djs/worker --if-present && npm run lint -w @djs/web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @djs/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @djs/api && npm run typecheck -w @djs/worker && npm run typecheck -w @djs/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @djs/shared-types --if-present && npm run test -w @djs/api --if-present && npm run test -w @djs/worker --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @djs/api && npm run test:e2e -w @djs/worker
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.docker:infra: docker compose up -d mysql redis || docker-compose up -d mysql redis
scripts.docker:up:obs: docker compose --profile observability up -d --build || docker-compose --profile observability up -d --build
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose run --rm --entrypoint /sbin/tini api -- npx tsx prisma/seed.ts || docker-compose run --rm --entrypoint /sbin/tini api -- npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.docker:scale-workers: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scale.yml up -d --scale worker=3 --build || docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scale.yml up -d --scale worker=3 --build
scripts.docker:logs:api: docker compose logs -f api || docker-compose logs -f api
scripts.docker:logs:worker: docker compose logs -f worker || docker-compose logs -f worker
